name: fixture-lights-all-on
description: Lights are one switch for the whole home: ON lights every fixture and the live count does not change as the camera moves (the old nearest-N budget lit 2 of 19 in walk mode and swapped them as you walked); OFF lights none. A per-light switch still wins.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-all-19-lit
steps.eval: (function(){var n=window.__lit0;if(n<19)throw new Error('expected all 19 default-flat emitters lit, got '+n);return 'ok '+n})()

steps.name: walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: assert-walk-same
steps.eval: (function(){if(window.__lit1!==window.__lit0)throw new Error('walk mode changed the live light count: '+window.__lit0+' -> '+window.__lit1);return 'ok'})()

steps.name: count-after-move
steps.eval: (function(){var n=0;window.__three.scene.traverse(function(o){if(o.isPointLight||o.isSpotLight)n++});console.log('LIGHTPROBE moved-lit='+n);if(n!==window.__lit0)throw new Error('moving the camera changed the live light count: '+window.__lit0+' -> '+n);return 'ok '+n})()

steps.name: back-to-orbit-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: back-to-orbit-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: assert-per-light-switch-wins
steps.eval: (function(){var n=0;window.__three.scene.traverse(function(o){if(o.isPointLight||o.isSpotLight)n++});if(n!==window.__lit0-1)throw new Error('per-light switch should remove exactly one: '+window.__lit0+' -> '+n);return 'ok '+n})()

steps.name: assert-none-lit
steps.eval: (function(){var n=0;window.__three.scene.traverse(function(o){if(o.isPointLight||o.isSpotLight)n++});console.log('LIGHTPROBE off-lit='+n);if(n!==0)throw new Error('lights off should render no fixture lights, got '+n);return 'ok'})()
